principle: Operational limits are owner-adjustable defaults. Only authorization, external access control, cryptographic integrity, master-stop, secret/privacy protection and untrusted-code isolation may be hard boundaries.

classifications.rationale: Device protection defaults; the owner can change and persist them.

classifications.control: provide an authorized public source, export or local file
classifications.rationale: Prevents SSRF and bypass of another system's authentication/access controls.

classifications.control: bounded duplicate chat-memory trace; full source remains in Knowledge
classifications.rationale: Avoids duplicating large indexed sources in every future prompt; expose in advanced settings.

classifications.control: test fixture/assertion; no runtime owner setting
classifications.rationale: Acceptance inputs, expected values and failure-injection bounds do not impose product runtime restrictions; never weaken them to alter owner controls.

classifications.control: AURORAFOX_FILE_MAX_*, AURORAFOX_ARCHIVE_*, AURORAFOX_OCR_MAX_* environment settings; restart backend
classifications.rationale: Parser resource defaults have environment overrides; visible owner UI and live propagation still pending.

classifications.control: context/title/URL budget remains source-defined; expose advanced control
classifications.rationale: Operational presentation/parser ceilings are not authorization boundaries and are not declared complete.
